passages.title: Is It Cold?
passages.zh: 今天冷嗎？（VOA 第 9 課）
passages.text:
Anna: Here in Washington, D.C., the {1} changes often. One day is cold and {2}. But the next day is warm and sunny! So every day I check the forecast. Hello, Phone? Is it {3} today?
Phone: No, Anna. It is not. There is no rain today.
Anna: Is it sunny today?
Phone: Yes, Anna. It is sunny.
Anna: Great! Today the weather is warm and sunny — {4} for seeing Washington, D.C.!

blanks.why: 一下冷一下暖、每天要查預報的是「天氣」→ weather（season 季節不會一天一變）
and 前後是同一組壞天氣：cold and ___。後面說 But…warm and sunny（好天氣）→ 這裡要跟 cold 一國的 windy
Phone 回答 There is no rain today（今天沒有雨）→ Anna 問的是 rainy
又暖又晴 → 是逛華盛頓的「好」天氣：great for + V-ing

passages.title: May I Borrow That?
passages.zh: 可以借我嗎？（VOA 第 46 課）
passages.text:
Anna: I forgot Marsha's birthday! I'll make her a gift. I'll just have to {1} a couple of things. Amelia, may I borrow your stapler?
Amelia: Sure. I can {2} you my stapler, Anna. But please {3} it. It's my favorite stapler.
Anna: You can trust me.
Jonathan: I can lend you my scissors too, {4} you must bring them back.
Anna: I will be very careful, and I'll bring them back tomorrow!

blanks.why: Anna 要「跟別人借東西進來」→ borrow（借入）；lend 是借「出去」給別人
Amelia 把自己的釘書機「借出去」給 Anna → lend＋人＋物；borrow 方向相反
最愛的釘書機借你，「但是請『還』它」→ return（keep 保留就拿不回來了）
可以借你「但是」必須帶回來 → 條件轉折用 but

passages.title: Back to School
passages.zh: 重返校園（VOA 第 50 課）
passages.text:
Taylor: I have been writing and re-writing my report since last night! The {1} is really interesting to me.
Sarah: Me too! I have been studying this topic for a long time.
Anna: Am I {2}?
Sarah: A little. But don't worry. The professor isn't here yet.
Anna: Oh no! I forgot my pencil sharpener. {3} me, do you have one I can {4}?
Taylor: No, sorry.
Anna: Oh wait. I found my extra one!

blanks.why: 下一句 Sarah 說 this topic（這個主題）→ 這裡指報告的「主題」：subject
回答是「有一點，但教授也還沒到」→ Anna 問自己是不是「遲到」了：late
開口請問別人之前的禮貌語 → Excuse me
跟同學「借」削鉛筆機（借入）→ borrow

passages.title: Can You Come to the Party?
passages.zh: 你能來派對嗎？（VOA 第 21 課）
passages.text:
Marsha: Hey, Anna, my friend is having a party on Saturday. Can you come with me?
Anna: Sorry, I can't. I have to take a test on the computer.
Marsha: But the party is at night. Everyone has to bring something or do something. You can bring food, or you can {1}.
Anna: Really? I can sing! Then I can come {2} the test!
Marsha: That's it! You can sing at the party. Now I have to go {3} for food. Can you help me?
Anna: {4}! I'm not busy right now.
notes: test＝考試（這裡指路考的筆試）

blanks.why: 帶食物「或者表演節目」（下一句 Anna 說她可以唱歌）→ perform
考試在白天、派對在晚上 → 考「完」之後再來：after the test
要為派對準備食物 → go shopping 去採買
答應幫忙的口語 → Sure!（當然好）

passages.title: I Can Fix This
passages.zh: 我搞得定（VOA 第 36 課）
passages.text:
Anna: I just need a couple of ingredients. Marsha, please hand me the flour.
Marsha: Anna, where is the flour? It's not in the cabinets.
Anna: I put the flour {1} the refrigerator. It's cold and dry there! Okay, now please hand me the eggs.
Marsha: Where are the eggs?
Anna: The eggs are in the cabinet {2} the sink.
Marsha: Anna, why are the eggs in here?!
Anna: Okay, okay. You {3} the living room. I will make dinner.
Marsha: Okay, the apartment is clean now. The kitchen is not. What are you cooking?
Anna: I made my favorite recipe! Sometimes when something goes wrong with your plan, just {4} the plan!

blanks.why: 下一句說「那裡又冷又乾」→ 麵粉被放「進」冰箱裡面：inside
雞蛋在「水槽下面」的櫥櫃 → under the sink
下文說 the apartment is clean now → 這裡是整個客廳的「打掃」：clean（sweep／wipe／mop 是特定動作）
計畫出錯就「改」計畫 → change the plan

passages.title: I Was Minding My Own Business
passages.zh: 我本來只是路過（VOA 第 42 課）
passages.text:
Guy: Anna, what did you see?
Anna: I left work to get some lunch. Then suddenly, I {1} a woman yelling, "Help! Help!" Two robbers {2} grabbing her bag.
Guy: Were you afraid?
Anna: I had no time to be afraid! The robbers ran away, so I ran after them. {3} I was running, I tripped and fell.
Guy: And that is when you {4} your arm?
Anna: While I was lying on the ground, someone stepped on my arm!

blanks.why: 整段在講「昨天發生的事」→ 過去式 heard（hear 的不規則變化）
過去進行式「正在搶」：主詞 Two robbers 是複數、事情發生在過去 → were + grabbing
「正在跑的『當下』」絆倒了 → While + 過去進行式
記者問「你就是那時弄『傷』手臂的嗎」→ hurt your arm

passages.title: What Will I Do?
passages.zh: 我會怎麼樣呢？（VOA 第 34 課）
passages.text:
Rebecca: Okay, tell me what I am thinking.
Anna: Sure! First, what do you do?
Rebecca: I {1}. I'm a junior in college.
Anna: What do you study?
Rebecca: I study journalism.
Anna: You are thinking... you {2} graduate from college in about one year. And you are thinking... you might get a {3} writing the news.
Rebecca: I MIGHT get a job? That means I might not! And I'm studying really hard!
Anna: No, no! You {4} get a job writing the news. You WILL!

blanks.why: 她是大學生，下一句也說 I study journalism → study
in about one year（大約一年後）是未來 → will graduate
get a job＝找到一份「工作」（寫新聞的工作）
Rebecca 抗議 might（可能）聽起來不確定 → Anna 改口保證「一定會」：WILL

passages.title: Just the Facts
passages.zh: 只要事實（VOA 第 18 課）
passages.text:
Caty: Okay, let's try the first story! And... go!
Anna: Hello, and welcome to The News. A new book is very popular with children and families. It is about a {1} duckling. The duck's mother cannot {2} him.
Caty: Stop! Anna, when you say "duckling," you look really sad.
Anna: This story is very sad!
Caty: Anna, happy and sad are feelings. You can't have feelings in The News!
Anna: In Indiana, a grandmother {3} the first 80-year-old woman to win the car race. She rarely talks to {4}. But when she does, she often says, "Nothing can stop me now!"

blanks.why: 下一句「鴨媽媽找不到牠」→ 是一隻「走失的」小鴨：lost
cannot ___ him＝「找」不到牠 → find
主詞 a grandmother 是單數、新聞報導用現在式 → is the first
贏得比賽的人很少「接受記者訪問」→ talks to reporters

passages.title: This Is My Neighborhood
passages.zh: 我的社區（VOA 第 11 課）
passages.text:
Anna: I need to return three books to the library. Where is the library?
Marsha: It is on this street, on the {1}.
Anna: And is there a {2} near here? I have four letters for my family!
Marsha: No, it is far from here. But there is a mailbox {3} the store.
Anna: Now I need to buy stamps. Do I have cash? No! Is there a {4} near here?
Marsha: There is one behind you.
Anna: Thanks, Marsha. You know our neighborhood so well!

blanks.why: 圖書館「在這條街的轉角上」→ on the corner
她有四封信要寄 → 找「郵局」post office
郵筒「在商店對面」→ across from the store
沒有現金（cash）→ 要找「銀行」領錢：bank

passages.title: Where Is the Gym?
passages.zh: 健身房在哪裡？（VOA 第 6 課）
passages.text:
Anna: Pete, I want to work out. Where is the gym?
Pete: The gym is {1} the lounge. It's next to the mailroom. Go that way.
Anna: Thanks, Pete!
Pete: No, Anna! Not that way! Go {2} way!
Anna: Oh, Pete. This is not the gym.
Pete: That's {3}, Anna. This is the mailroom.
Anna: Pete! This is not the gym! This is a parking garage!
Anna: I am {4} in my own office building. This is a rooftop!

blanks.why: 說位置：健身房「在交誼廳對面」→ across from
皮特指著另一邊：「走『那』邊！」→ Go that way
Anna 說這不是健身房，皮特說「沒『錯』，這是收發室」→ That's right（你說對了）
在自己公司大樓裡繞到屋頂 → 「迷路了」：lost

passages.title: How About This? (1)
passages.zh: 這件如何？（VOA 第 14 課・上）
passages.text:
Anna: Tonight I am going to the theater with my friends. But I don't know what {1} to wear!
Genie: I am Genie! I am here to help you find the right clothes!
Anna: Awesome! How about jeans and a {2}?
Genie: No! Jeans and a T-shirt are too casual. How about something more formal?
Anna: Wow! Genie, this {3} is beautiful. But it's not the right size. It's too {4}.
Genie: Yes, it is. But green looks great on you! Let's try a green shirt and a skirt.

blanks.why: 不知道要「穿什麼衣服」→ what clothes to wear（去劇院要整套打扮，不是只挑襪子）
下一句 Genie 說 Jeans and a T-shirt are too casual → 空格是 T-shirt
去劇院的正式服裝、之後改試 shirt and skirt → 這裡試穿的是「洋裝」dress
尺寸不對（not the right size）→ 太「小」：too small

passages.title: How About This? (2)
passages.zh: 這件如何？（VOA 第 14 課・下）
passages.text:
Anna: These clothes are formal: a suit jacket, a dress shirt and a {1}! They look great!
Genie: Those clothes look great... for a man! Let's try again.
Genie: Oh! Now these clothes look great on you!
Anna: They do! Um, Genie, can you put on a gold {2}?
Genie: Sure! That looks great.
Anna: I love the jacket! How about a hat?
Genie: Why not?
Genie: Mm, {3} the hat. That's better.
Anna: Genie, these clothes look and feel great! {4} more, they are the right size!

blanks.why: 男士正式穿著三件組：西裝外套＋襯衫＋「領帶」→ tie（後面也說這套適合男生）
金「腰帶」配洋裝 → a gold belt
帽子不好看 → 「脫掉」帽子比較好：take off the hat
補充另一個優點「而且尺寸剛好」→ What's more

passages.title: Halloween Is Coming!
passages.zh: 萬聖夜來了！（VOA 第 34 課）
passages.text:
Anna: Hello! {1} is very popular in the United States. Children go trick-or-treating. They ask people for {2}. Children and adults wear {3} and go to parties! In fact, there is a party tonight. I don't have a costume. Can you help me, Genie?
Genie: Dress as a genie!
Anna: Great idea! Hey, look! I'm a genie! This is going to be {4}!

blanks.why: 小孩去 trick-or-treating（不給糖就搗蛋）的節日 → Halloween
萬聖夜挨家挨戶要的是「糖果」→ ask people for candy
萬聖夜大人小孩都穿「道具服」參加派對 → costumes
打扮好要去派對，Anna 很期待 → This is going to be fun!
